claims: Colombia won the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
Colombia defeated Argentina 4-0 in the final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
The final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship took place on April 19, 2026.
The final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship took place in Paraguay.
Colombia's win in the 2026 U-17 South American Championship secured their second title.
Argentina ended the final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship with nine players due to late red cards.
Andrés Mosquera scored a goal at 53' in the final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
José Escorcia scored a goal at 67' in the final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
José Escorcia scored a goal at 83'+ in the final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
Filipe Chavarria scored a goal in the final of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
Colombia defeated Brazil 3-0 in the semifinals of the 2026 U-17 South American Championship.
The 2026 U-17 South American Championship is the CONMEBOL U-17 Championship.
